open: Floor heights: no open source measures them.

Where the lift and escalator are, and what the upper floor (OSM level 1) is called on signs: JLT confirms both exist, no source places them; OSM's footbridge w903469223 and stairs w1425083737 lead to unknown places (OSM's API could not be read with WebFetch, robots disallowed).
Toilet fee/payment: Jernhusen (2026) says card, JLT (2022) says SMS or coins; fee amount not published.
Exact positions of toilets, lockers, photo booth inside the hall: Jernhusen doesn't say; JLT's map text labels none.
Pressbyrån's hours from its own website: the store finder loads by script; OSM's hours kept.

Swedish Wikipedia's article could not be fetched (only a Wikiwand copy: station built 1983 by Carl Nyrén, four tracks, two for passenger trains, waiting hall for buses and trains added 2001); no photos checked on Commons.
A 2009 municipal survey mentions 'övergången över järnvägen till Västra Strandpromenaden' (a crossing over the railway); whether this is the OSM footbridge, and whether it has a lift, is not known.

answers.question: level L0 (Station, bus terminal and platform): height not measured
answers.answer: Still open: no open or owner source measures it.

answers.question: platform 1: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Likely correct. JLT's map shows the station, bus terminal and tracks 2a, 2b and 1 side by side at street level, and JLT says the station has no ramp. OSM's only lift (level 0;1), stairs and footbridge reach no platform; JLT's lift and escalator have no stated position. Not confirmed by a plan or photo.
answers._source: JLT terminal map Jönköping Resecentrum, https://www.jlt.se/globalassets/dokument-2026/terminalkartor/jlt_terminalkartor_jonkoping_rc.pdf (valid from December 2025), read 2026-10-30; facts only; JLT, "Vad finns på våra stationer?" https://www.jlt.se/res-med-oss/tillganglighet--ledsagning/tillganglighet-pa-vara-stationer/ (page last updated 2022-07-15), read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts/740000090.json, ODbL), read 2026-10-30

answers.question: platform 2: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Likely correct, as for platform 1: platform 2 (2a/2b) runs along the station building at street level; a 2009 municipal survey describes walking 'direkt från tågperrong 2A över parkeringen uppför Järnvägsgatan'. No source places a lift or stairs on it.
answers._source: JLT terminal map Jönköping Resecentrum, https://www.jlt.se/globalassets/dokument-2026/terminalkartor/jlt_terminalkartor_jonkoping_rc.pdf (valid from December 2025), read 2026-10-30; facts only; Trivector for Jönköpings kommun, 'Start- och målpunktsundersökning på Jönköpings Resecentrum' (2009-01-25), https://www.jonkoping.se/download/18.74fef9ab15548f0b8003715e/1465889943061/Start-%20och%20m%C3%A5lpunktsunders%C3%B6kning%20f%C3%B6r%20J%C3%B6nk%C3%B6pings%20resecentrum.pdf, read 2026-10-30
